places.quote: arranged for a carriage being sent after him to the City
places.note: Dickens's shorthand for the City of London financial district; Carker rides there off-stage.

places.quote: not oblivious of the Peruvian mines, as the establishment in general had good reason to know
places.note: Allusion to Mrs Pipchin's speculation in Peruvian mining; the country is named only through the phrase.
